NOW.headline: ServiceNow Exec at AUSA Defense Business Will be 'Major Driver' Over Next Year
NOW.summary: In this NYSE Live interview from the AUSA Annual Meeting & Exposition, Kevin Brooks, Vice President of Global Defense and National Security at ServiceNow, discusses how workflow automation, artificial intelligence, and digital modernization are reshaping defense and government operations. Brooks begins by explaining the importance of the defense sector within ServiceNow's growth strategy. As government agencies continue investing in operational efficiency and digital transformation initiatives, demand for enterprise workflow platforms remains strong across military and civilian organizations. A significant portion of the discussion focuses on defense logistics and service management. Brooks highlights efforts to streamline complex operational environments through system consolidation, workflow automation, and improved service delivery capabilities that help organizations operate more effectively. The interview also explores how AI is improving efficiency throughout government and defense organizations. By automating repetitive administrative processes and accelerating information flows, AI can support faster decision-making and enable personnel to focus on mission execution rather than manual tasks. Another major theme is operational modernization. Brooks explains that organizations increasingly require technology solutions capable of integrating workflows across departments while improving transparency, responsiveness, and collaboration. The conversation further examines the role of cybersecurity. Through partnerships and platform enhancements, ServiceNow is helping organizations gain greater visibility into assets, access management, and security operations while supporting broader cyber resilience initiatives. The interview also discusses the impact of acquisitions and strategic partnerships, including efforts to incorporate AI-enabled employee support experiences and intelligent service delivery capabilities into the ServiceNow ecosystem. Additionally, Brooks highlights opportunities to expand ServiceNow's presence beyond traditional enterprise functions. As military and government organizations modernize, enterprise platforms are increasingly being used to support operational missions, field activities, and more complex organizational workflows. Looking ahead, Brooks believes artificial intelligence, workflow automation, cybersecurity, and enterprise modernization will remain key priorities across defense and national security sectors, creating opportunities for continued technology adoption and innovation. JD Durkin and Brooks also discuss the growing role of AI in military readiness, operational efficiency, and the modernization priorities shaping the future of defense organizations. Throughout the discussion, Brooks shares perspectives on defense modernization, military technology, AI adoption, cybersecurity, logistics, workflow automation, government transformation, enterprise software, and the future of digital operations. SNOW.headline: Snowflake CMO NYSE Setting is 'Huge Inspiration' for Startup Campaign Finalists
SNOW.summary: In this NYSE Live interview, Denise Persson, Chief Marketing Officer at Snowflake, discusses how artificial intelligence, trusted data, and enterprise innovation are reshaping business operations and modern marketing. Persson begins by reflecting on Snowflake's Startup Challenge and the significance of bringing innovative early-stage companies to the New York Stock Exchange. She describes the NYSE as an inspiring environment for entrepreneurs and founders working toward ambitious long-term goals. A significant portion of the discussion focuses on the common characteristics shared by this year's finalists. According to Persson, the participating startups are leveraging data and AI to solve unique business challenges while building on the Snowflake platform's data infrastructure and analytics capabilities. The interview also explores the importance of data governance. Persson argues that AI systems are only as trustworthy as the data they are built upon, making governance, quality, transparency, and security foundational requirements for achieving reliable business outcomes. Another major theme is the impact of AI on marketing organizations. Persson explains that marketers are gaining new capabilities around personalization, audience engagement, workflow automation, and customer experience optimization. At the same time, organizations must navigate increasingly complex data ecosystems while ensuring responsible AI implementation. The conversation further examines Snowflake's own AI adoption strategy. The company's marketing team has progressed from experimentation to broad adoption and is now focusing on transformational use cases that drive measurable business value while improving operational efficiency. The interview also highlights how AI is helping creative and marketing teams automate production-intensive tasks. Automating repetitive work allows employees to dedicate more time to strategy, creativity, customer engagement, and innovation. Trust remains another key area of discussion. Persson believes organizations must be transparent about how customer data is used and protected, particularly as AI-powered personalization becomes more prevalent. Strong governance and ethical data practices will play a central role in earning and maintaining consumer trust. Additionally, the conversation explores what remains uniquely human in an AI-powered future. Persson points to creativity, judgment, strategic thinking, customer empathy, and trust-building as areas where human expertise will remain essential even as automation capabilities continue to advance. Looking ahead, Persson expects AI to become an increasingly powerful tool for helping organizations improve decision-making, streamline operations, and create more meaningful customer experiences while empowering employees to focus on higher-order work. Throughout the discussion, Persson shares perspectives on artificial intelligence, data governance, enterprise technology, marketing transformation, customer trust, startup innovation, business intelligence, digital strategy, and the future of AI-powered organizations.
